// An image of unit direction vectors (a tangent-space or world-space normal
// map), stored unencoded: components in [-1, 1], not remapped to color range.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normal_mapping)
type NormalImage
    implements IImage
{
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    Normals: Array<Vector3D>;
}
